correctness.rationale: Idempotents of W_n are exactly interval clamps e_[a,b]. For f commuting with e, the middle restriction a<=u=f(a)<=v=f(b)<=b gives C(k,v-u) monotone binary-step strings; a left tail is freely 2^(a-1) choices only if u=a and otherwise constant; similarly a right tail 2^(n-b) only if v=b. Expand weighted binomial sum to obtain (k+2)2^(k-1)+(L+R-2)2^k+(L-1)(R-1), including k=0 singleton and k=n-1 identity limits. Summing over interval positions yields A_n=(4n-12)2^n+(n²+9n)/2+12 and probability 32/n²+O(n^-3). Clamps commute exactly when intervals overlap, and interval Helly property yields n maximal semilattices H_j and inclusion-exclusion clique polynomial. Independently generated all W_n maps, tested every e,f composition and matched all centralizers and aggregate A_n for each n=2..7 (A_4=102; A_7=2116).
